title: Kate's Brave Bike Ride
summary: A shy girl named Kate discovers her courage when she rides her bike to help a lost child find their way home.

pages.text: Kate lived in a cozy home at the edge of a small town.
pages.scene: A young girl with a bicycle standing in front of a cute cottage

pages.text: She loved to ride her bike on the safe path near the lake.
pages.scene: Kate riding peacefully along a lakeside trail

pages.text: One time, Kate heard a small voice that came from far away.
pages.scene: Kate stopping, hearing a child crying in the distance

pages.text: "Where is my home? I am so lost!" cried a little boy.
pages.scene: A small, scared boy standing alone in an unfamiliar place

pages.text: Kate felt brave inside and said, "Come ride on my bike!"
pages.scene: Kate making a courageous decision to help

pages.text: She rode fast and took the right path up the slope.
pages.scene: Kate pedaling determinedly, the boy safe on her bike

pages.text: The boy smiled wide when he could see his home.
pages.scene: Child recognizing his house in the distance

pages.text: His mom came outside and gave Kate a big hug.
"Kate, you are the bravest, nicest girl!" said the mom.
pages.scene: Mother praising Kate while the boy watches happily

pages.text: Kate rode home with her heart full of pride.
pages.scene: Kate cycling back, feeling strong and confident

pages.text: She had made a new friend and learned she was brave all along.
pages.scene: Kate under clear skies, transformed by her heroic deed
Kate and boy waving, a beautiful friendship beginning

phonics_focus: i_e (bike, ride, time, pride, wide, smile)
